mapper.select: select wp.id, wp.staff_id, wp.points_type, wp.points_value, wp.points_source, wp.source_id, wp.source_desc, wp.rule_id, wp.auto_generated, wp.expire_date, wp.used_points, wp.available_points, wp.transaction_type, wp.transaction_time, wp.operator, wp.remark, wp.status, s.sname, s.sid, DATE_FORMAT(wp.expire_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as expire_date1, DATE_FORMAT(wp.transaction_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as transaction_time1, COALESCE(( SELECT COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN wp2.transaction_type = 'EARN' AND wp2.status = 1 THEN wp2.points_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN wp2.transaction_type = 'USE' AND wp2.status = 1 THEN COALESCE(wp2.used_points, wp2.points_value, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0 ) FROM hr_welfare_points wp2 WHERE wp2.staff_id = wp.staff_id AND wp2.status = 1 ), 0) as current_available from hr_welfare_points wp left join hr_employee s on wp.staff_id = s.id where wp.id = #{id} and wp.status = 1

select wp.id, wp.staff_id, wp.points_type, wp.points_value, wp.points_source, wp.source_id, wp.source_desc, wp.rule_id, wp.auto_generated, wp.expire_date, wp.used_points, wp.available_points, wp.transaction_type, wp.transaction_time, wp.operator, wp.remark, wp.status, s.sname, s.sid, DATE_FORMAT(wp.expire_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as expire_date1, DATE_FORMAT(wp.transaction_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as transaction_time1, COALESCE(( SELECT COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN wp2.transaction_type = 'EARN' AND wp2.status = 1 THEN wp2.points_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN wp2.transaction_type = 'USE' AND wp2.status = 1 THEN COALESCE(wp2.used_points, wp2.points_value, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0 ) FROM hr_welfare_points wp2 WHERE wp2.staff_id = wp.staff_id AND wp2.status = 1 ), 0) as current_available from hr_welfare_points wp left join hr_employee s on wp.staff_id = s.id where wp.staff_id = #{staff_id} and wp.status = 1 order by wp.transaction_time desc

select wp.id, wp.staff_id, wp.points_type, wp.points_value, wp.points_source, wp.source_id, wp.source_desc, wp.rule_id, wp.auto_generated, wp.expire_date, wp.used_points, wp.available_points, wp.transaction_type, wp.transaction_time, wp.operator, wp.remark, wp.status, s.sname, s.sid, DATE_FORMAT(wp.expire_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as expire_date1, DATE_FORMAT(wp.transaction_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as transaction_time1, COALESCE(( SELECT COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN wp2.transaction_type = 'EARN' AND wp2.status = 1 THEN wp2.points_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN wp2.transaction_type = 'USE' AND wp2.status = 1 THEN COALESCE(wp2.used_points, wp2.points_value, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0 ) FROM hr_welfare_points wp2 WHERE wp2.staff_id = wp.staff_id AND wp2.status = 1 ), 0) as current_available from hr_welfare_points wp left join hr_employee s on wp.staff_id = s.id where wp.status = 1
order by wp.transaction_time desc limit #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}

select staff_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'EARN' AND status = 1 THEN points_value ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_earned, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'USE' AND status = 1 THEN COALESCE(used_points, points_value, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_used, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'EARN' AND status = 1 THEN points_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'USE' AND status = 1 THEN COALESCE(used_points, points_value, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0 ) as current_available from hr_welfare_points where staff_id = #{staff_id} and status = 1 group by staff_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(transaction_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, points_value, transaction_type, points_source, auto_generated FROM hr_welfare_points WHERE staff_id = #{staff_id} AND status = 1 AND transaction_type = 'EARN' ORDER BY transaction_time ASC
